label: SpecStream: Web Search
description: Search the live web through SpecStream and get results with the passage of each page that best matches the query, ready for an LLM node. Wire a SpecStreamAccess node. Each text is cut at `maxTextChars`, and the longest ones shorter still when the results would weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The SpecStream access (wire a SpecStreamAccess node).

inputs.name: query
inputs.label: Query
inputs.description: Everyday words in any language. Operators such as `site:`, `-site:`, `"exact phrase"`, `after:2026-01` and `before:2026-06` hold on every result.

inputs.name: maxTextChars
inputs.label: Text per result
inputs.description: Max page-text characters per result (1-10,000). When the results would still weigh more than the 100 KB a wire carries, the longest texts are cut shorter until they fit.

inputs.name: site
inputs.label: Site
inputs.description: Only results from this one domain. Empty = the whole web.

outputs.name: results
outputs.type: List[{ title: String | Null, url: String, publishedDate: String | Null, text: String | Null }]
outputs.description: Each result: title, url, the date the page says it was published, text.
